assertions: Every canonical definition act produces a local definition record.
Definition records retain defined expression, exact defining text, type, scope, applicable context, exclusions, competitors, challenge links, confidence, and review.
Definitions remain local unless later evidence explicitly broadens scope.
Nearest bounded definition challenges remain linked without adjudicating the definition.
Every canonical example act produces an example record.
A single nearest prior generalization is probable and review-required.
Several candidate generalizations remain alternatives and no candidate remains unresolved.
Example records preserve real, hypothetical, quoted, and uncertain states.
Example records cannot claim representativeness or proof.
Every canonical quotation act produces a quotation-use record.
Matched quotation uses copy exact Phase 4 quotation structure and attribution provenance.
Acoustic speaker, quoting speaker, attributed speaker, and original source remain distinct fields.
Phase 5 quotation use cannot mutate Phase 4 acoustic attribution.
Construction run and report artifacts are sealed, replayable, and reusable.
CLI operations build, validate, inspect, and list definitions, examples, quotation uses, and unresolved structures.
Schema export includes all six Stage 7 contracts.
limitations: Definition extraction is limited to explicit structural wording.
Example target selection is a bounded candidate heuristic, not semantic proof.
Participant references remain empty without explicit structured evidence.
The controlled fixtures qualify construction mechanics, not natural-conversation semantic accuracy.
